spec: 10 §8.1 (states), 10 §8.2 (transition table, one vector per row), 10 §8.3 (S1–S6), 10 §8.4 (TS lifecycle strings), 10 §10.1 (events), 13 §5.1 (ts-compat event sequences), 13 §6.7 (realistic reports)
notes: Row ids r01–r21 follow the order of the 10 §8.2 table. `profiles` says where the row can occur: `ts-compat`, `realistic` (backtest simulator), `live` (paper/live adapter). G2 scope (60 §10.2) covers the profile-independent and ts-compat rows; realistic-only rows are G3 and live-only rows are G4, but every row has a skeleton.

`events` is the row's event list from 10 §8.2. `ts_compat_events` is the same transition's full delivered sequence under the compat models of 13 §5.1 (the acceptance-time SettlementUpdate{Matched, fill: None} of 10 V1 and, for FOK, the Confirmed update), which the ts-compat test asserts instead.

States: InFlight, Delayed, Live, Unknown (non-terminal); Filled, Canceled(cause), Expired, Killed, Rejected(reason) (terminal). CancelState (None, Deferred, InFlight, Acked, Failed, Unknown) is orthogonal.
`forbidden` lists transitions and event patterns that MUST NOT occur, each derived from the cited clause. A forbidden row passes when the pattern is absent from every trace the G2 scenarios produce.

vectors.input: intent passes engine validation, dedupe, risk and funding
vectors.scenario: GTC BUY UP 5 @ bid(UP) - 0.01 with capital; assert the first event for the cid is OrderSubmitted and portfolio().order(cid).state == InFlight inside that callback (12 §9.2: submitted_delivered)

size 0 (InvalidSize), price 0 (InvalidPrice), post-only FOK (PostOnlyRequiresResting), insufficient capital (InsufficientCapital{required, available}); assert no OrderSubmitted precedes the rejection, no order record exists (portfolio().order(cid) is None), no OrderKey consumed

vectors.input: exchange rejects at arrival (rules, post-only cross, market closed)
vectors.scenario: ts-compat: post-only GTC BUY at best ask (equality crosses, 11 §4) -> OrderSubmitted then OrderRejected(PostOnlyWouldCross). realistic: also InvalidTick (price off the tick in force), PriceOutOfBounds, SizeBelowMinimum, MarketClosed (arrival at/after end)

vectors.note: ts-compat inserts the TS acceptance-time MATCHED update (10 V1, 13 §5.1 step 2) between OrderAccepted and OrderOpen

vectors.scenario: GTC BUY at best ask with size <= visible depth -> fills then OrderDone(Filled); with size > depth -> fills then OrderOpen (remainder rests; ts-compat free-remainder quirk 13 §5.3 may fill it on the next tick)
vectors.note: FOK in ts-compat appends SettlementUpdate{Confirmed, fill: None, size_matched: size} after OrderDone(Filled) (13 §5.1 step 3)

vectors.scenario: realistic, market in a non-zero delay row (11 §6.2), marketable GTC BUY
tick_size_change lands during the delay making the price off-tick -> OrderRejected(InvalidTick) at release
book moves away during the delay: GTC -> OrderOpen; FOK -> OrderDone(Killed, filled: 0)

vectors.input: cancel arrives, non-cancellable era (11 §6.2 cancelable_in_window = false)
vectors.scenario: market with arrival in D3/D4/D5; cancel inside the window; the order continues and is released normally
realistic queue model partial fill; ts-compat never produces it (WorstQueueCompat fills the whole remainder, 13 §5.1)
vectors.ts_compat_note: unreachable in ts-compat: assert no Fill of a resting order leaves it Live

vectors.scenario: ts-compat: resting GTC BUY @ P; next real in-window tick with best ask < P -> one MAKER fill of the whole remainder at P, fee 0, then OrderDone(Filled)
ts_compat_events: Fill(MAKER, price = limit, qty = remainder, fee = 0)

vectors.scenario: resting GTC; cancel_order cid; with delay 0 the OrderDone(Canceled(Strategy(op)), filled = size - remaining) is synchronous; no CancelAcked ever

vectors.input: cancel arrives at the exchange (realistic, live)
vectors.to: Live + CancelState::Acked on CancelAcked, then Canceled(cause) on OrderDone
vectors.note: either delivery order is allowed (L_cancelAck vs L_fill); a CancelAcked after the terminal event is ledgered/journaled but not delivered to the strategy; CancelAcked changes nothing but CancelState

vectors.scenario: ts-compat: at the first real in-window tick with tick.ts >= expire_at_ms, checked before fills on that tick; realistic: at exchange time stated_s x 1000 - 60000

vectors.input: window end, market close, heartbeat loss, kill switch, rotation
vectors.scenario: realistic: a resting order at client time end -> engine CancelMarket{Market} cause WindowEnd (travels with L_cancel); an order still resting at the exchange-side close -> Canceled(MarketClosed). ts-compat: NO action at market end (TC-C13): the order simply remains in the final open-orders set
ts-compat: FOK BUY with sum of opposite sizes within the limit < size -> killed, no fills (13 §5.1 step 3); e.g. exerciser x6 (FOK BUY @ bid - 0.05)
vectors.note: the TS ws_order_update(CANCELED) after a FOK kill has no Rust counterpart (13 §5.4); not emitted
FAK has realistic semantics in both profiles (no TS oracle; 12 §7.4); remainder never rests

vectors.input: reconciliation finds the order open / filled / absent

vectors.note: applied to cash, position and filled; the state stays terminal; realistic can produce it only when report latencies differ (13 §6.7); 60 INV-5 allows nothing after the terminal event except flagged late fills

forbidden.pattern: any OrderDone or OrderRejected for an OrderKey that already received one
OrderAccepted, OrderOpen, OrderDelayed or CancelAcked delivered to the strategy for a terminal OrderKey
forbidden.note: late CancelAcked is ledgered, not delivered (10 §8.2 row 14)

forbidden.pattern: OrderSubmitted followed by OrderRejected{origin: Engine} for the same intent
OrderOpen for a FOK or FAK order
OrderDone(Killed) for a GTC or GTD order
OrderDelayed in a ts-compat session or trace
CancelAcked in a ts-compat session or trace
a Fill for an order whose terminal event is OrderRejected
sum of delivered fill qty > size (shares) or spend > amount (collateral)
two non-terminal orders with the same cid at once
a strategy event for an order this session did not place
any Ctx accessor exposing the market's final outcome to the strategy
forbidden.note: checked by API review of pmb-sdk rustdoc in C2, not by a trace

cases.final: unresolved; reservation stays (live only; the simulator always sets filled)

invariants.statement: late fills, fills past a cascade limit and fills before the ack are buffered and applied, never dropped
